_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Complacency band with no downside breaker and no ETF/momentum climb signal, so the skilled call is hold the coil rather than force a leg.
next_move.brains_agree: partial — analyst explicit HOLD/Complacency; narrative flow story is compatible with sideways but does not confirm a climb or flush
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-54, funding near flat, BTC range-bound, 30d momentum stuck low-40s
next_move.invalidated_if: F&G breaks under 46 with weak CVD and ETF flows near zero (flush toward Anxiety), or ETF flows rebound 40+ with momentum through 55 (climb toward Disbelief)
